questions.question: What did Rachel secretly take from her father Laban?
How did Rachel hide the stolen idols during Laban's search?
options: She buried them deep beneath the tent floor
She sat on them in the camel's saddle
She handed them over to Jacob
She threw them down into a well
questions.answer: She sat on them in the camel's saddle
